avis.titre: Impossible to use all of the product & way too expensive
avis.texte: I love this formula (better than the ordinary, unfortunately). Way too expensive and the dropper is imo inappropriate. It's annoying to dispense or control the amount of product and the dropper keeps some of the product. No fragrance, feels incredible before or after moisturizer. I have acneic rosacea and am in my 30s. I think Paula's Choice products are overpriced but this is the most effective "ectoin" product I've found

I love this serum, I just wish it weren’t so expensive. I mix this with my moisturizer morning and night and my skin is so soft. It feels so hydrating immediately after applying. I have sensitive skin and haven’t experienced any irritation with this serum. Will purchase again!

This stings the hell out of my skin even when my barrier is strong, and ironically dried me out. I’m sure it’s not a universal problem and there’s something in here that my skin just doesn’t like, but this price point (for MUCH LESS product than a standard 1oz serum) for a simple hydration serum that isn’t a safe bet is CRAZY WORK.

This has really helped my dry skin. Utahs weather is so dry so I’ve been using this under my regular moisturizer and it has helped tremendously! My skin does feel more radiant at times. It’s a little pricey for how much product you get.

I was so excited to receive this product because of reviews that say it’s works really well for reactive skin however, upon opening the serum, I noticed it seemed old and dropper hardly worked. Also, after applying it, it seemed smooth, but immediately after I didn’t feel as though, I had applied anything on it all.

avis.titre: Fantastic for anti-aging and barrier repair
avis.texte: This is prob some of the most effective skincare I’ve ever used and I’ve tried it all from drugstore to high end. I wish it came in a bigger size, it goes fast and did not last the month.

This is so incredibly soothing! I started getting dark spots with increasing my retinal percentage and I have seen a difference in less than 24 hours. The immediate burst in hydration and reduced inflammation makes an almost instantaneous difference in the skin. There is no fragrance and a very little goes a long way.
This product is pretty good, but this is a very small amount.

I’m a big fan of this product. I use it at night after I wash my face. It absorbs into my skin really well and feels really hydrating. I tend to have dry skin and live in the Midwest with a furnace running in the house, so this extra moisture for my skin is really nice. It does immediately give my skin a visible boost where it looks smoother and slightly plumper. It says it can be used alone or with moisturizer. I find it hydrating enough to not need additional moisturizer. It does say to use a sunscreen over it if used during the day, so I assume there’s an ingredient in it that causes sun sensitivity. As with every Paula’s Choice product I have ever used, I find it to be a high quality, effective product. I do wish the bottle was a bit bigger because I’m unsure how long one bottle will last, but I love the product itself. This review is for “Paula's Choice 7% Ectoin + Hyaluronic Acid Milky Hydrating Face Serum, 7-in-1 Barrier Repair, Deep Hydration, Dewy Finish, Dermatologist-Tested for Sensitive Skin, 0.67 Fl Oz”

Definitely adds a silky shine to your skin and hydrates, but in my middle age it does end up looking a bit more hot flash sweaty than it does hydrated and dewey. You can see my before and after picture on the same area of skin with just this one product how it hydrates it does feel a little bit slick to the touch after putting it on. It says that you can use it with your moisturizer, but I really don’t think both are needed. I noticed one unwanted effect from using this is that there’s almost a mask like shine with a delineated edge around the hairline where your normal scalp skin is and then all of a sudden the shiny skin from the liquid. I have not experienced any skin sensitivity from this and I have used it each day for over a week so far.

avis.titre: Great at hydrating and forming a skin barrier to lock in moisture
avis.texte: I’ve heard of this brand before and it’s been promoted as a more budget friendly but still quality skin care brand so I did find this item to be slightly more expensive than what I would want in this category of skin care items. However, it does enhance my skin barrier, locking and moisture, and providing a slightly Dewey finish. I didn’t experience the extreme doing us that they show in the advertising photos, but it did seem to make my skin more subtle softer and slightly doing it. I use it in combination with my moisturizer and with the winter months it has really been a lifesaver at keeping my skin from drying out. usually in the winter months I experience moderate to severe dryness and flakiness, but using this has really helped and I have an experience that. I didn’t notice skin brightness, but maybe after time I will. The material is a white, thin, milky substance that absorbs easily, and feels very hydrating. It has no scent and cause no irritation whatsoever overall, I don’t know if I would buy this again because it is slightly expensive but give it a try and maybe it’ll work for you.

avis.titre: price is probably the biggest drawback
avis.texte: I find it's tricky to review skin care products because of the length of time you'd need to be using it in order to possibly see the results that are claimed, as well as not use any other product at the same time that could affect the results. That being said: this is my first experience with a Paula's Choice product. It's an itty-bitty bottle that's pretty expensive. The serum is thicker than I'd expected (which I kind of like) and it went on smoothly. I did not detect any odor as some other reviewers did. I have had no skin reaction to it (I don't tend to have sensitive skin). My skin does feel very soft once it's rubbed in, but I can't say it looks particularly "dewy" afterward. I will continue to use it and watch to see if it improves my skin quality, but the bottom line for me is that the cost of the product will probably not justify its purchase again.

avis.titre: Unpleasant smell, hard to gauge how much to use
avis.texte: I tried this, but ended up having to wash it off because of the smell. I know there’s not supposed to be any scent to it, and maybe I just got a bad product, but it was an unpleasant, almost seaweedy smell. Of the listed ingredients (ectoin, hyaluronic acid, squalane, jojoba seed oil, vitamin E, and water), ectoin is the only one I’ve never tried -- I’ve never experienced this odor with any of the other ingredients. I’m really bummed because I trust Paula’s Choice as a brand, and I think they do high quality products, but I can’t with this smell. The texture is sort of a medium viscosity that feels light, and I used about one dropper for my full face. It was easy to apply, but I felt like maybe I used more than I really needed to. I’m not sure how long this would end up lasting. Opaque containers are better for preservation, but it’s frustrating not knowing how much is left. My skin felt reasonably hydrated with it on, but I prefer creams as a general rule, and again, I couldn’t get past the smell. It does seem a little on the expensive side at $44 for such a small bottle.

avis.titre: Give your regular Hyaluronic acid a BOOST!
avis.texte: I’ve been purchasing Paula’s Choice products for a few years now & I’m never disappointed in the products I’ve bought from them. Everything does what it says it will. This is my first time using this & my skin feels so dewy & moisturized as the listing describes it will. My skin looked immediately plump & “happy”. The milky texture melted into my skin like butter, my skin soaked it right up. I put this on right after my regular Hyaluronic acid & followed it with more moisturizer. My skin is happy & so soft! There’s a slight smell but not a bad one, it’s barely there as you have to literally put it up by your nose to smell anything. It comes in a glass bottle that’s not see through which protects the product from light which causes the product to lose its potency & reduces its shelf life. Great product! Performs exactly as described.

This is hydration in a bottle. The combination of Ectoin and Hyaluronic Acid works wonders for dry, dehydrated skin. It adds a beautiful healthy glow. It is lightweight and absorbs quickly. This serum is gentle and fragrance-free. This has repaired my skin barrier nicely. My face feels softer and more resilient after just a few uses. I have skin that is on the sensitive side, and this serum caused no issues. I use this serum on clean dry skin and apply it before a moisturizer during my morning and night routines. It has made my skin feel a bit plumper, which also helps diminish fine lines and wrinkles. Highly recommend if you need a moisture boost.

This booster arrived without cellophane safety wrap. It lost one star as a result. The bottle is very small—the size of my index finger, I have small hands. It passed my skin test-no adverse reaction. It gained a star. This product looks very creamy and moisturizing in advertising photos, however, mine is a bit sticky. It reminds me of the white, liquid glue used in elementary school classrooms. There is a slight unpleasant odor that dissipates quickly. I decided to try it on the backs of my hands. It felt drying. I immediately added my favorite lotion and found relief. This booster can be added to creams, lotions, or serums but why should I do that when the products that I use give immediate results without it? This product takes about 2 weeks to see results, costs much more than the products I have that work directly without the wait, and comes in a tiny bottle that will quickly empty if used twice daily. Additionally, sunscreen needs to be applied after using. I do not consider this product a good value for the money or the time required to see results. I will try it for two weeks. If it does what it claims I will give it a better rating. For now it gets 3 stars in the hopes that it works.

This looks really promising from an ingredient standpoint. Ectoin is a great barrier-supporting and hydrating molecule, so this serum is likely to help calm irritation, boost moisture, and protect skin from environmental stress. The formula also includes squalane, hyaluronic acid, and glycogen. All gentle, skin-friendly hydrators that should give a smooth, glowy finish without irritation. However, the packaging came in dented and looked opened. Overall, it seems like a solid choice if you’re looking to strengthen your skin barrier, add long-lasting hydration, or support skin that’s easily stressed or dehydrated. The bottle size is really small compared to others. And for $44, the price is on the higher range for such a small bottle. If you’re oily skin then you may need to check the ingredients for comedogenic factors. I will be back for how effective the product is!

avis.titre: Gentle and seems effective but cost prohibitive.
avis.texte: Paula's Choice face serum contains Ecotin & Hyaluronic acid to soothe, help protect, restore resilience & visibly repair the skin. The serum is thick and is distributed with a dropper. It goes on smooth and absorbs quickly. I have very sensitive skin but found this to be gentle and did not experience any redness or irritation. This package contains only 3/4 oz and is currently listed for $44. That makes it very cost prohibitive, especially since it requires an separate additional sunscreen for daytime usage. I have only been using for a few days, but so far so good. The Paula's Choice brand has a good reputation. If cost were not an issue I would recommend.

This is a FANTASTIC hydrating milky serum that my super dry skin loves. It's a serum consistency that absorbs clear and gives a dewy (not greasy) glow. Under makeup it's lovely and really hydrates to allow makeup to glide on and not settle into fine lines. Alone, you just look refreshed and glowing. I feel that the size of the bottle is good for the price, as you only need a small amount to cover your entire face. It's completely fragrance free and did not upset my sensitive skin. I'm really excited to have a product in my lineup that leaves my skin soft and hydrated-even between washes. I'm impressed with its effectiveness.

The product is good quality and comes in solid packaging. It would be even better if it were fully enclosed in a glass container to minimize any potential exposure to microplastics. The material does not irritate the skin and has no unpleasant odor. Overall, it performs its intended function well. Although it is expensive, the quality justifies the price.
